pick.name: Supabase Pro
pick.why: Postgres plus auth, storage and realtime in one; Pro adds daily backups and removes pausing
pick.free_limits: Pro from $25/mo incl. $10/mo compute credits (covers one Micro instance; extra projects pay full compute), daily backups kept 7 days. Free: 500 MB DB, 50k MAU, 1 GB storage, 2 active projects, paused after 1 week of inactivity, no backups

best_free.name: Neon Free
best_free.what: Serverless Postgres with branching and scale-to-zero
best_free.why: Most generous commercial-OK free Postgres for many small products: 100 projects, no inactivity deletion, branch-per-PR
best_free.free_limits: 100 projects; 100 CU-h/project/mo; 1 GB/project (20 GB total); 5 GB egress/project; 10 branches; 6 h history (no instant restore); suspends after 5 min idle; Launch $0.106/CU-h + $0.35/GB-mo
best_free.maintained: active; owned by Databricks since May 2025

alts.name: Prisma Postgres Free
alts.what: Managed Postgres from the Prisma team
alts.why: Alt if you use Prisma ORM; spend fixed at $0
alts.free_limits: 200k operations/mo, 2 GB storage, 50 DBs; Starter $10/mo (1M ops, 10 GB)

alts.name: Self-hosted Postgres
alts.what: Run Postgres yourself on a VM
alts.why: No vendor lock-in; you own backups and HA

candidates.name: Neon
candidates.verdict: PICK: 100 projects, branching, commercial-OK ToS, no pausing deletion

candidates.name: Supabase
candidates.verdict: Alt: best BaaS bundle but 2 projects, 1-week pause, no free backups

candidates.name: Prisma Postgres
candidates.verdict: Alt: simple, but 200k ops/mo cap is tight for an API

candidates.name: Cloudflare D1
candidates.verdict: SQLite not Postgres; 5 GB, 5M rows read/day free; good for Worker-only side projects

candidates.name: Turso
candidates.verdict: libSQL/SQLite; 100 DBs, 5 GB, 500M reads/mo free; pick for per-tenant SQLite

candidates.name: Koyeb Postgres
candidates.verdict: Free 5h tier only, company being acquired

candidates.name: Self-host Postgres on an always-free VM
candidates.verdict: Free but you own backups/HA; fine for internal tools

decision: Supabase Pro is the best overall when you want managed Postgres with auth, storage and backups on one bill. Neon Free is the best free Postgres: 100 projects, branching, commercial-OK, no deletion on inactivity. Choose Neon Launch instead of Supabase if you only need Postgres with branching and usage-based billing.
details: Neon owned by Databricks since May 2025. From Workers use the Neon serverless driver or Hyperdrive (free-plan terms unverified).

verify.note: Verified: Free 500 MB DB, 50k MAU, 1 GB storage, 2 active projects, paused after 1 week inactivity; Pro from $25/mo incl. $10 compute credits (one Micro instance), daily backups kept 7 days.
